liveDebuggerTrace.target: Town Square T21 in the Stone Hill replacement slot
liveDebuggerTrace.sampleScope: The distant view where the user-visible flicker persisted
liveDebuggerTrace.result: T21 reached the +0x51 renderer-admitted draw-attempt state in every sampled frame.
liveDebuggerTrace.interpretation: Within this 60-frame sample, T21 was not omitted from the update/draw queue and passed the coarse CPU-side sphere/frustum gates before vertex projection.
liveDebuggerTrace.scopeLimitation: +0x51 is set before whole-model clipping, per-face clipping, NCLIP, depth/order selection, and primitive packet emission; it is not by itself proof that visible pixels reached the frame.

livePrimitiveEmissionTrace.result: Moved T21 emitted GPU primitive packets in all 12 sampled frames, just like both native controls. Its packet-size variation overlaps the normal rotational variation of T22 and T47.
livePrimitiveEmissionTrace.interpretation: The visible collapse is downstream terrain overdraw/intersection, not missing Moby scheduling, coarse culling, whole-model clipping, or all-face rejection.

spatialDiagnosis.screenCaptureResult: In unobscured frames T21 alternated between a 1-2 pixel dark sliver and a bright white X while native controls remained 8-15 pixels tall.
spatialDiagnosis.orderingTableExplanation: Spyro 1 painter-sorts gem faces and adjacent terrain into the world ordering table without a z-buffer. T21's rotating face depth and silhouette therefore alternately peek around and are overdrawn by the wall it intersects.

diagnosticConclusion.renderRadiusResult: +0x50 = 7F did not eliminate the flicker and must not be promoted.
diagnosticConclusion.updateScheduleResult: +0x52 = FF did not eliminate the flicker and must not be promoted.
diagnosticConclusion.queueAndCullingConclusion: The sampled flicker is not queue omission or primitive dropout: +0x51 admitted T21 in all 60 sampled frames and T21 emitted primitive packets in all 12 downstream samples.
diagnosticConclusion.rootCause: The -128 X test coordinate places the radius-24 rotating gem only 9.25 units from and therefore inside a vertical wall's envelope.
diagnosticConclusion.nextBoundary: Restore native +0x50 = 18 and +0x52 = 40, then test an X-only open-ground placement at X=7600 with decoded wall clearance 31.699.

scopeLimitations: The combined 0x7F/0xFF candidate is runtime-rejected and must not be promoted.
The 60-frame debugger result is limited to the sampled failing view and does not establish a universal renderer diagnosis.
